hypothesis: The existing tensor-core MMQ path may outperform MMVQ for dense Q8_0 four-column work on sm_121
reason_for_unprivileged_path: Native hardware counters require unavailable administrator authorization. Ordinary backend timing does not require changing counter permissions.
scope: Only the Q8_0, four-column decision in the existing sm_121 MMVQ dispatch branch. Leave routed MoE, all other types, batches and architectures unchanged. No new kernel or launch-parameter sweep.

source.build: Incremental original Release build; isolate the candidate DLL and restore original source/build DLL before benchmarking

correctness.geometry: Six original GGUF Q8_0 shapes, each with 1, 4 and 8 columns
correctness.required: All cases pass, plus the existing supported four-column Q8_0 backend cases
correctness.dispatch_proof: An ordinary Nsight Systems software trace of a selected four-column case must show MMQ rather than MMVQ

operator_screen.runner: Existing test-backend-ops perf mode; no profiler or elevated process
operator_screen.limitations: Repeated same-tensor graphs favor cache reuse and include backend/RHS-quantization overhead. Not a DRAM-bandwidth measurement or full-model speed prediction.

full_model_gate: Only an operator-screen survivor receives the existing two-sample Rust/JSON MTP screen: >=3% gain in each case, nonoverlapping ranges, reverse order only after survival, then quality/repeated-stack confirmation before deployment
stop_policy: Stop on correctness, dispatch or operator-screen failure; do not change thresholds after measurements
